name: computer-use-automation
description: Record UI automations once with an LLM, then replay them deterministically as typed capabilities. Tools: list_capabilities, run_capability, discover_capability.

target_url.title: Application URL
target_url.description: Where the application runs, e.g. https://core.bank.example or https://bank.example/portal. Capabilities replay here and discovery starts here. Leave empty to use the URL each capability was recorded on.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Used only by discover_capability. Replay never calls a model.
